name: Laddu Gopal Online Services Limited
about: Laddu Gopal Online Services Limited offers property development and infrastructure project services in India. It is involved in the development and management of software technology centers, multimedia houses, information technology parks, and other related activities. The company was formerly known as ETT Limited and changed its name to Laddu Gopal Online Services Limited in February 2025. Laddu Gopal Online Services Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Noida, India.
